description: This file contains functions for creating visualizations (bar plots and Gantt-like plots) of behavioral observation data, including data retrieval from a database, data processing, and plotting with matplotlib. It is part of the BORIS software for behavioral research.

methods.name: default_value
methods.description: Returns a default value for behavior parameters, especially for point events.

methods.name: init_behav_modif
methods.description: Initializes a dictionary with subjects, behaviors, and modifiers with default values.

methods.name: init_behav
methods.description: Initializes a dictionary with subjects, behaviors, and parameters with default values.

methods.name: create_behaviors_bar_plot
methods.description: Creates bar plots showing durations and number of occurrences of behaviors over selected observations.

methods.name: create_events_plot
methods.description: Creates a Gantt-like plot visualizing behavior events over time for selected observations.
